description: This file defines the Border class in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, representing a border in document elements such as tables or paragraphs, with properties for style, width, color, visibility, and serialization features.

classes.name: Border
classes.description: Represents a single border in a borders collection, encapsulating style, width, color, visibility, and serialization logic.

methods.name: Border
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the Border object with default values.

methods.name: Border
methods.description: Internal constructor accepting a parent DocumentObject.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Border instance.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the border settings, marking it as cleared.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets whether the border is visible.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Gets or sets the line style of the border.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the line width of the border.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Gets or sets the color of the border.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Gets the name of the border ('top', 'bottom', etc.) within its parent.

properties.name: BorderCleared
properties.description: Indicates if the border is marked as cleared.

inner_classes.name: BorderValues
inner_classes.description: Contains internal nullable values for Border properties, used for serialization and property management.
